test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

BPX : ENB :: KUW : NSA :: FOY : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c87af255da423c5c57cf30844a27c7d72b28ec5bb040bf1a06a86a5300f67d91.png] 

**Logic:** Addition of (3) and (4) in the first and third letter's position value and subtraction of (2) from the second letter's position value.

BPX : ENB →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cac1c69c1f7a1c648c47fa725fb847ba64806c496e99cecd08535ee89702cd4f.png] 

KUW : NSA →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc6ada7e241701efc690ab31ad909fc583c84f4b5dc2dbcea957cda0cbeca460.png] 

Similarly, for 'FOY : ?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad0ecc4a48985e9a8fec3146f2d5caacf8a1120993f701b53205998d9fec0e04.png] 

Here, 'FOY : IMC' is the correct pair.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
